---
mode: agent
description: TASKSTOISSUES — Convert tasks.md + stories.md to GitHub Issues export
---

## Before Starting
- Read .specify/manifest.yml
- Read .specify/features/{manifest.project.feature}/tasks.md
- Read .specify/features/{manifest.project.feature}/stories.md (if exists)

## What This Does
Converts your approved tasks and stories into two export formats:
1. `tasks-to-issues.md` — GitHub-flavored markdown: one issue per task/story, ready to copy-paste into GitHub
2. `gh-create-issues.sh` — Shell script using the `gh` CLI to bulk-create issues automatically

## Action — Generate Issues Export

### Story issue format (for each STORY-NNN)

```
## [STORY-NNN] {story title}

**Labels:** `sdd-story`, `priority:{must-have|should-have|could-have}`, `sprint:{sprint}`
**Milestone:** {manifest.project.feature}
**Story Points:** {points}

### User Story
{story text from stories.md}

### Acceptance Criteria
{acceptance criteria list}

### Child Tasks
{list of TASK-NNN items belonging to this story}
```

### Task issue format (for each TASK-NNN)

```
## [TASK-NNN] {task title}

**Labels:** `sdd-task`, `story:{STORY-NNN}`, `{scope}`
**Milestone:** {manifest.project.feature}
**Estimate:** {estimated lines} lines

### Description
{task description from tasks.md}

### Acceptance Criteria
Implements: {STORY-NNN} acceptance criteria items addressed by this task

### Definition of Done
- [ ] Code written and tests passing
- [ ] PR reviewed and merged
- [ ] STORY-NNN acceptance criteria verified

### Spec Links
- Story: STORY-NNN — {story title}
- tasks.md: `.specify/features/{feature}/tasks.md`
```

### Shell script structure

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Auto-generated by /taskstoissues — SDD Framework
# Creates GitHub Issues from tasks.md and stories.md
# Requirements: gh CLI authenticated (run: gh auth login)
# Usage: bash gh-create-issues.sh

set -euo pipefail

REPO="${GITHUB_REPO:-$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner 2>/dev/null || echo "")}"
if [[ -z "$REPO" ]]; then
  echo "Set GITHUB_REPO=owner/repo or run from inside a git repo with gh configured."
  exit 1
fi

MILESTONE="{manifest.project.feature}"

echo "Creating issues in $REPO for milestone: $MILESTONE"

# Create milestone
gh api "repos/$REPO/milestones" --method POST -f title="$MILESTONE" -f state="open" 2>/dev/null \
  && echo "  ✓ Milestone created" || echo "  · Milestone already exists"

# Create labels
gh label create "sdd-story" --color "e4e669" --description "SDD user story" --repo "$REPO" 2>/dev/null || true
gh label create "sdd-task"  --color "0075ca" --description "SDD implementation task" --repo "$REPO" 2>/dev/null || true
gh label create "priority:must-have"    --color "b60205" --repo "$REPO" 2>/dev/null || true
gh label create "priority:should-have"  --color "e99695" --repo "$REPO" 2>/dev/null || true
gh label create "priority:could-have"   --color "f9d0c4" --repo "$REPO" 2>/dev/null || true

# Stories
{for each STORY-NNN: gh issue create command with title, body, labels, milestone}

# Tasks
{for each TASK-NNN: gh issue create command, referencing parent story issue number}

echo ""
echo "Done! View issues at: https://github.com/$REPO/issues?milestone={encoded milestone}"
```

Fill in the actual `gh issue create` commands from the real STORY-NNN and TASK-NNN items in
tasks.md and stories.md. Use `--title`, `--body`, `--label`, `--milestone` flags.

## Save Outputs

Save to:
- `.specify/features/{manifest.project.feature}/github-issues/tasks-to-issues.md`
- `.specify/features/{manifest.project.feature}/github-issues/gh-create-issues.sh`

Make the shell script executable: `chmod +x gh-create-issues.sh`

State: "Issues exported. Files saved to `.specify/features/{feature}/github-issues/`.
Run `bash gh-create-issues.sh` to create them (requires `gh` CLI authenticated)."
